notes.notes:

A new patch for Notch - The Innocent LunA: Eclipsed SinnerS has been released. If you encounter any bugs or mistakes, feel free to report it in this thread.

Update log:

1. Fixed an issue the game not working correctly.

2. Updated some resources.

3. Some other small fixes.

And, during Steam's Christmas event all our catalog will be on sale up to 60% off! For details please visit the link here:

http://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Angels%20Blue%20Digital%20Entertainment

Wish you have a merry Christmas!

notes.title: Notch Update 10th Jan, 2016
notes.notes:
A new patch for Notch - The Innocent LunA: Eclipsed SinnerS has been released. This patch fixes several bugs we found. If you encounter any bugs or mistakes, feel free to report it in this thread.

Update log:

1. Fixed a bug involving the zoom effect.

2. Updated the script to avoid savedata corruption under certain circumstances.

3. Fixed a bug about the message box not working correctly.

4. Added & modified several background CG.

5. Some other small fixes.

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Notch - The Innocent LunA: Eclipsed SinnerS Update #651302
notes.notes:
A new patch (BuildID 651302) for Notch - The Innocent LunA: Eclipsed SinnerS has been released, please restart your Steam client and it will automatically update to the latest version.

*Fixed a crash related to some non-Unicode systems.

*Fixed some translation mistakes. 

======================================================

《刻痕》的一个新补丁（BuildID 651302）已经被推送，请重新启动Steam客户端，它将自动更新游戏至最新版本。

*解决在某些非unicode系统环境下可能出现的游戏崩溃问题。

*修复了部分文字翻译错误。
